#| context: setup
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import pandas as pd

COLOR_PRIMARY = "#C8102E"
COLOR_OK = "#2E7D32"

# === SCORES AUTO-EVALUES (a mettre a jour) ===
LIVRABLES = {
    "Livrable 1 — Production RDI": {
        "obtenu": 0, "max": 90,
        "icon": "📄",
        "rubriques": [
            ("Publications scientifiques", 0, 50),
            ("Production technique", 0, 20),
            ("Projet RDI 2 ans", 0, 20),
        ],
    },
    "Livrable 2 — Production Pédagogique": {
        "obtenu": 0, "max": 65,
        "icon": "🎓",
        "rubriques": [
            ("Supports pédagogiques (SPOC, capsules)", 0, 30),
            ("Intégration de technologies", 0, 20),
            ("Apport de l'expérience professionnelle", 0, 15),
        ],
    },
    "Livrable 3 — Grille 3.1 RDI/Socio": {
        "obtenu": 0, "max": 20,
        "icon": "🌍",
        "rubriques": [
            ("Activités socio-éco / socio-culturel", 0, 4),
            ("Encadrements RDI / Socio-culturels", 0, 5),
            ("Contribution équipes RDI", 0, 3),
            ("Coaching clubs / associations", 0, 4),
            ("Produits grand public", 0, 4),
        ],
    },
    "Livrable 3 — Grille 3.2 Pédagogique": {
        "obtenu": 0, "max": 35,
        "icon": "📚",
        "rubriques": [
            ("Accompagnement Moniteurs/AT/EF", 0, 10),
            ("Développement professionnel", 0, 10),
            ("Enseignements (création modules)", 0, 7.5),
            ("Encadrement étudiants (PFE, projets)", 0, 7.5),
        ],
    },
    "Livrable 3 — Grille 3.3 Rayonnement": {
        "obtenu": 0, "max": 60,
        "icon": "🏆",
        "rubriques": [
            ("Animation de formations", 0, 10),
            ("Organisation de manifestations", 0, 10),
            ("Responsabilités péda/admin", 0, 20),
            ("Pilotage événements scientifiques", 0, 5),
            ("Contrats-projets entreprises", 0, 10),
            ("Jurys recrutement / passage de grade", 0, 5),
        ],
    },
    "Grille 4 — Dossier & Entretien": {
        "obtenu": 0, "max": 70,
        "icon": "💬",
        "rubriques": [
            ("Évaluation du Dossier", 0, 20),
            ("Évaluation de la Présentation", 0, 20),
            ("Évaluation de l'Entretien", 0, 30),
        ],
    },
}

total_obtenu = sum(v["obtenu"] for v in LIVRABLES.values())
total_max = sum(v["max"] for v in LIVRABLES.values())
pct = round(100 * total_obtenu / total_max, 1) if total_max else 0

def gauge(value, max_val, title, color=COLOR_PRIMARY, height=180):
    fig = go.Figure(go.Indicator(
        mode="gauge+number",
        value=value,
        domain={"x": [0, 1], "y": [0, 1]},
        title={"text": title, "font": {"size": 13}},
        gauge={
            "axis": {"range": [0, max_val], "tickfont": {"size": 10}},
            "bar": {"color": color, "thickness": 0.85},
            "bgcolor": "white",
            "borderwidth": 1,
            "bordercolor": "#DDD",
            "steps": [
                {"range": [0, max_val * 0.5], "color": "#FFEBEE"},
                {"range": [max_val * 0.5, max_val * 0.75], "color": "#FFCDD2"},
                {"range": [max_val * 0.75, max_val], "color": "#EF9A9A"},
            ],
            "threshold": {"line": {"color": "black", "width": 2},
                           "thickness": 0.85, "value": max_val * 0.7},
        },
    ))
    fig.update_layout(height=height, margin=dict(l=15, r=15, t=40, b=10),
                       font=dict(family="Inter, sans-serif"))
    return fig
```

#| title: "Jauge globale /340"
fig = go.Figure(go.Indicator(
    mode="gauge+number+delta",
    value=total_obtenu,
    delta={"reference": int(total_max * 0.70),
            "increasing": {"color": COLOR_OK},
            "decreasing": {"color": COLOR_PRIMARY}},
    domain={"x": [0, 1], "y": [0, 1]},
    title={"text": f"<b>Score / {total_max}</b>", "font": {"size": 18}},
    gauge={
        "axis": {"range": [0, total_max], "tickwidth": 1},
        "bar": {"color": COLOR_PRIMARY, "thickness": 0.85},
        "steps": [
            {"range": [0, total_max * 0.5], "color": "#FFEBEE"},
            {"range": [total_max * 0.5, total_max * 0.7], "color": "#FFCDD2"},
            {"range": [total_max * 0.7, total_max * 0.85], "color": "#FFE0B2"},
            {"range": [total_max * 0.85, total_max], "color": "#C8E6C9"},
        ],
        "threshold": {"line": {"color": "black", "width": 4},
                       "thickness": 0.9, "value": int(total_max * 0.70)},
    },
))
fig.update_layout(height=380, margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=60, b=20),
                   font=dict(family="Inter, sans-serif"))
fig.show()
```

### Column {width=45%}

```{python}
#| title: "Progression par livrable (obtenu / restant)"
labels = list(LIVRABLES.keys())
obtenus = [LIVRABLES[k]["obtenu"] for k in labels]
maxs    = [LIVRABLES[k]["max"] - LIVRABLES[k]["obtenu"] for k in labels]
totaux = [LIVRABLES[k]["max"] for k in labels]

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    name="Obtenu", x=obtenus, y=labels, orientation="h",
    text=[f"{o}/{t}" for o, t in zip(obtenus, totaux)],
    textposition="inside",
    marker_color=COLOR_PRIMARY,
))
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    name="Reste", x=maxs, y=labels, orientation="h",
    marker_color="#E0E0E0",
))
fig.update_layout(
    barmode="stack", template="plotly_white", height=380,
    margin=dict(l=10, r=20, t=20, b=20),
    xaxis_title="Points", yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.2, x=0.5, xanchor="center"),
    font=dict(family="Inter, sans-serif"),
)
fig.show()
```

# Décomposition par sous-rubrique

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Sunburst : Livrable → Sous-rubrique (avancement)"
rows = []
for liv, info in LIVRABLES.items():
    for rub_name, rub_obtenu, rub_max in info["rubriques"]:
        rows.append({"livrable": liv, "rubrique": rub_name, "max": rub_max,
                     "obtenu": rub_obtenu, "reste": rub_max - rub_obtenu})

df_rub = pd.DataFrame(rows)

import plotly.express as px
fig = px.sunburst(
    df_rub,
    path=["livrable", "rubrique"],
    values="max",
    color="obtenu",
    color_continuous_scale=[[0, "#FFEBEE"], [0.5, "#EF9A9A"], [1, "#2E7D32"]],
    hover_data=["obtenu", "reste"],
)
fig.update_layout(height=520, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=20, b=10),
                   font=dict(family="Inter, sans-serif"))
fig.show()
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Détail des sous-rubriques avec barres de progression"
import pandas as pd

rows_table = []
for liv, info in LIVRABLES.items():
    for rub_name, rub_obtenu, rub_max in info["rubriques"]:
        pct = round(100 * rub_obtenu / rub_max, 1) if rub_max else 0
        bar = "█" * int(pct / 5) + "░" * (20 - int(pct / 5))
        rows_table.append({
            "Livrable": liv,
            "Sous-rubrique": rub_name,
            "Barème": f"/{rub_max}",
            "Obtenu": rub_obtenu,
            "Avancement": bar,
            "%": f"{pct}%",
        })

df_table = pd.DataFrame(rows_table)
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True, connected=True)
show(df_table, lengthMenu=[10, 25], classes="display compact", paging=False)
```

# Aide

## Row

::: {.card title="Comment mettre à jour les scores"}

Le tableau de bord lit ses scores depuis le dictionnaire `LIVRABLES` défini en
tête du fichier `dashboards/grille-efs.qmd`. Pour mettre à jour :

1. Ouvrir `dashboards/grille-efs.qmd`
2. Modifier les valeurs `obtenu` dans la section `LIVRABLES = {...}`
3. Re-build : `quarto render` (ou push si workflow GitHub Actions actif)

Toutes les jauges, valueboxes, sunburst et tableau se recalculent automatiquement.

:::

::: {.card title="Détail des seuils"}

| Couleur jauge | Plage |
|---|---|
| Rouge clair (#FFEBEE) | 0 – 50 % |
| Rose | 50 – 70 % |
| Orange | 70 – 85 % |
| Vert | 85 – 100 % |

Le **seuil noir vertical à 70 %** indique le minimum recommandé par grille.

:::
